about_the_game:
Step into a dazzling celebration in the heart of Venice. While there’s a gentle touch of storytelling to set the scene, the true centerpiece of the game is its rich variety of puzzles and engaging hidden object challenges. Enjoy an atmosphere of festivity and flair, where every new scene is an invitation to explore, solve, and uncover visual delights.

Follow Mimi Brook, an aspiring young photographer, as she travels with her family to Venice during its world-famous Carnival. Together, they explore the city’s colorful traditions, mask-filled streets, and breathtaking sights. While the Brooks share touching moments and make lasting memories, you’ll be immersed in a journey packed with hidden object challenges and clever tasks.

Lose yourself in an endless mosaic of gameplay. Every scene is crafted to test your perception, focus, and puzzle-solving skills, ensuring there’s always something new to uncover!
